title: Success and Cost Elicit Convention Formation for Efficient Communication
one_sentence: 显示 success 与 message cost 的联合训练压力可在受限 repeated visual reference games 中诱发对人类可读的 convention-like efficiency gains。
problem: 能否在没有新增 human demonstration data 的情况下训练 LMM 随互动形成更短且更成功的 referring expressions？
method: 以 simulated photo/tangram reference games 生成 success+cost preference pairs，进行 DPO-style post-training，再以 model-speaker→human-listener games 比较 baselines。
findings: 来源报告 message length 最高下降 41%，success 随互动最高提高约 15%，human listeners 反应更快。
success-only 或 cost-only 均不足，联合目标才产生 efficiency trajectory。
real_contribution: 把 convention formation 转成可干预的 training-objective problem，并提供 human-listener behavioral validation。
biggest_weakness: 固定单向 speaker→listener；全 history 位于 context window，未测 role reversal、repair、mutual belief、partner swap 或 physical embodiment。
claim_boundary: 证明 convention-like efficient reference policy 可被训练，不证明双方共同协商或 interaction-history-specific mutual convention 已形成。
why_researcher_should_care: 直接削弱‘AI 不能形成 convention-like adaptation’的宽泛表述，并指出 success×cost 是值得因果检验的 selection pressure。
evidence_notes: Published July 2026; outside the strict seven-day publication window and labeled first-run recovery.
Full ACL paper and limitations were audited.
